text:
lia: quick heads-up — planning a gradual canary for the v2 runtime config today. target deploy window 12:30 PDT. samir is the deploy owner. cohorts: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10%. timeline ~20m / 30m / 40m. need smoke + rollback ready :eyes:

samir: I got the deploy. will kick at 12:30. can someone volunteer to run the post-bump smoke and validate latencies? I'll watch traffic shift and logs.

jordana: I can run the smoke steps after the 0.5% bump. plan: quick text-gen probe + kv cache hit rate check. will post results here.

kai: I'll be on rollback if needed. rollback command (dry-run tested):

```bash
redwoodctl rollout revert --env=prod --service=inference-runtime --tag=v2-runtime-2026-03-17 --yes
```

I'll also pre-seed the canary pool with a warm-up traffic mix to avoid cold-start spikes.

lia: jordana/ kai — can you confirm smoke checklist? suggested minimal steps: 1) 5 sample prompts to each cohort, 2) ensure p50/p99 latency < SLA, 3) token error rate < 0.1%, 4) KV cache hit ratio unchanged (+/- 2%).

jordana: confirmed. I'll run: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'` and a tiny loop to sample 50 reqs. posting results at +5m after bump.

prod-bot: Deploy slot reserved by samir for 2026-03-17T19:30:00Z (UTC). Reminder in 15m.

dheeraj: quick note on cohorts — prefer using geo-balanced slice for first two ramps (NA + EU) then open to global at 10%. avoids local overload. also ensure database read-only fallback flagged for 10% test.

samir: good call. i'll set routing policy: "geo-balanced" for 0.5% and 2%, global for 10%. adding DB read-only flag to 10% rollout config.

lia: rollback readiness check — kai, do you have the artifact pinned and the previous tag to restore?

kai: yes: previous tag `v1-runtime-stable-20260221`. artifact cached in staging registry and warm images in prod pool. 2-min rollback target confirmed.

jordana: smoke after 0.5%: p50=85ms, p99=420ms, errors=0.02%, kv-hit=78% (baseline 80%). I'll keep monitoring for the 2% step.

samir: thanks — proceeding to bump to 0.5% now. will post when shift completes.

lia: thanks team. once 0.5% is green for 15m we move to 2% per timeline. if any threshold breach -> immediate halt and rollback. calling out thresholds: p99 > 2x baseline, error rate > 0.5%, kv-hit drop >5%.

prod-bot: Traffic shift to cohort 0.5% completed.

samir: observed slight p99 uptick to 1.6x baseline, still under emergency threshold. holding for 15m.

jordana: holding pass — no errors spike. will start 2% bump prep at :00.

dheeraj: FYI ops-alerts are on for the rollout group. will page if any infra anomalies.

kai: standing by for rollback command if required.

lia: excellent. will post final status in 45m. :rocket:
